caseNameFull: Champlin Refining Co. v. Ryan, Secretary of State
attorneys: Mr. Horace G. McKeever for appellant., No appearance for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeal herein is dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. Section 237 (a), Judicial Code, as amended by the act of February 13, 1925 (43 Stat. 936, 937). The petition for writ of certiorari is denied^
